lines: Meet Reef Sentinel. One platform to run your entire hotel.
Your day at a glance. Arrivals, available rooms, bookings, and month-to-date revenue, all updated live.
The room chart puts every reservation on a single timeline.
Confirmed stays, in-house guests, and free rooms, visible instantly.
Taking a direct booking takes seconds. Pick the dates, and check availability.
Choose a room and rate plan.
Add the guest's details, and the price, with tax, is calculated instantly.
Confirm, and the booking is done.
When guests arrive, the front desk sees today's arrivals.
Assign a room, and check them in with a single click.
Point of sale is built in. Add outlets like a restaurant, a bar, or a spa.
Each one gets its own menu, taxes, and service charge.
Staff take orders right from the menu.
Send the order to the kitchen.
Then charge the bill straight to the guest's room.
Every charge, from the room to the restaurant and the bar, lands on one guest folio, ready for a smooth checkout.
Add your team in seconds.
And give each person exactly the access they need, down to individual outlets.
And real-time reports on revenue and occupancy keep management in the loop.
Reef Sentinel. Every stay, perfectly managed.
